decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card advantage engine in a control shell. The goal is to control the board with removal spells and disruptive cards while ramping into Niv-Mizzet Reborn to refill your hand with multicolored cards. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by flickering key permanents. The deck also includes a diverse mix of threats and answers to handle a variety of situations, ultimately aiming to out-value and outlast the opponent in a long game.

This deck focuses on using the synergy between various creature cards like Amalia, Dina, and Wildgrowth Walker to generate life gain and board presence. It also includes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key combo pieces. The goal is to set up a board state where you have a high life total and can use Aetherflux Reservoir to deal a lethal amount of damage to your opponent in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Cenote Scout and Extraction Specialist to help support the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on using the combo potential of Amalia Life cards to gain life, generate mana, and control the board. With key pieces like Wildgrowth Walker, Aetherflux Reservoir, and Temple Garden, the deck aims to create a strong board presence while setting up for powerful combo plays with cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling. By utilizing the life gain and mana ramping abilities of the deck, players can quickly assemble their combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with a flurry of powerful plays.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain control of the game by using removal spells, counter spells, and card advantage to outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by efficiently removing threats and countering key spells while drawing cards to generate card advantage. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Jace and Valki to provide additional value and win conditions. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to both blue and black mana sources to cast spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the key card. By utilizing cards like Collected Company, Chord of Calling, and Return to the Ranks, the deck aims to quickly find and play Amalia, with support from cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper to generate extra mana. Once Amalia is on the field, the deck can use Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a large amount of life and deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes creature removal and protection to ensure the combo can be executed successfully.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Wildgrowth Walker, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Extraction Specialist to gain life and create a board presence. The goal is to set up a combo with Aetherflux Reservoir, using cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to find the pieces needed. The deck also includes some protection with Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition. Overall, the key strategy is to gain enough life to activate Aetherflux Reservoir and use its ability to deal a lethal amount of damage to the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards and gain card advantage, while controlling the board with a variety of removal spells and counterspells. The deck also includes a toolbox of diverse cards to be fetched with Bring to Light, allowing for flexibility in different game situations. The inclusion of a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, adds an additional element of value by blinking permanents for extra card advantage. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game through card advantage and versatility in spell choices.

This deck focuses on applying pressure on the opponent through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and efficient threats. The deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Kroxa and Sheoldred to close out the game quickly. The land base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy with a mix of mana-fixing lands and utility lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in gameplay.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of angel and valkyrie creatures, while also utilizing cards like Collected Company to generate value and tempo. The key strategy is to establish a strong offensive with creatures like Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel, while also having tools like Skyclave Apparition for removal and Kayla's Reconstruction for recursion. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays while maintaining card advantage to secure victory in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 matchup.

The deck focuses on utilizing Grisly Salvage and Otherworldly Gaze to fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Zetalpa, Primal Dawn and Soulflayer. Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality help disrupt the opponent's plans while providing additional graveyard fodder. Smuggler's Surprise can help cheat out creatures early. The deck also includes Goldvein Hydra and Tomebound Lich for additional threats. The mana base includes a mix of lands to support the deck's color requirements. Overall, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with big, impactful creatures.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to utilize hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also generating card advantage and value from cards like Liliana of the Veil and Geier Reach Sanitarium. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, and ultimately win the game by out-valuing and outlasting the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Waste Not and Reckoner Bankbuster provide additional ways to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards to generate a high amount of life gain and utilize it as a resource to win the game. By utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Wildgrowth Walker, and Aetherflux Reservoir, the deck aims to gain a significant amount of life while controlling the board with cards like Skyclave Apparition and Selfless Savior. Collected Company and Chord of Calling help in finding key pieces of the combo, while Return to the Ranks can help rebuild the board if needed. This synergistic approach allows the deck to quickly gain a dominant position in the game.

This deck revolves around using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece for control tactics. It focuses on utilizing a wide range of multicolored cards, including Leyline Binding and Bring to Light, to maintain board control and draw power. Additionally, the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional versatility and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through a combination of removal spells, ramp spells, and powerful threats such as Omnath, Locus of Creation. By utilizing Niv-Mizzet as a card advantage engine, the deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with its flexibility and resilience.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to put pressure on the opponent early in the game, utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Ghitu Lavarunner to chip away at their life total. Burn spells like Wizard's Lightning and Skewer the Critics are used to finish off the opponent or clear the way for the creatures to attack. The deck aims to maintain board presence and keep the pressure on, overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck is built around sacrificing your own creatures for value, triggering abilities like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to deal damage to your opponent. It also utilizes Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to bring back key creatures from the graveyard and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create tokens for additional sacrifice fodder. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with constant pressure and efficient removal spells like Fatal Push. With a focus on synergy and resource management, this deck aims to win through a combination of aggression and attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to cast multiple spells in a turn to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and attack aggressively. It combines various card draw and selection spells to find the necessary pieces quickly, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Ashiok, Dream Render and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Hall of Storm Giants and Temporal Trespass ensures a strong late-game presence. Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster provide additional graveyard synergy and control options, making this deck a fast-paced and versatile Aggro archetype.
